people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: When his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king’s son-in-law. Before the deadline,
translations.bsb: When the servants reported these terms to David, he was pleased to become the king’s son-in-law. Before the wedding day arrived,
translations.kjv: And when his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king's son in law: and the days were not expired.
translations.asv: And when his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king's son-in-law. And the days were not expired;
